budget_relation: Independent diagnostic only; 5-minute per-job cap is below all original affected 20/60/120-minute job caps. No original execution is extended or restarted.
changes_prohibited: current source PR or original run changes
configuration_read: /etc/resolv.conf and its two exact systemd-resolve targets
next_required_binding: Root-reviewed isolated workflow/harness identity and original complete terminal artifact; none created or admitted by this candidate.
output_semantics: Retain all original observation outputs and public configuration hashes before/after. Incomplete configuration, timed-out/nonzero lookup or changed configuration returns nonzero. Successful lookup still does not establish apt HTTP/package readiness, explain the original failed runner, or qualify original CI.
secret_avoidance: No auth.conf, key files, environment dump or raw apt source configuration. Only hash and bounded public source URI projection; userinfo/query/fragment/unrecognized path contents omitted.
